note: State park campground in woods above the Kettle River gorge near Sandstone, with sandstone quarry ruins and climbing cliffs along the river. Five canoe-in sites on the river are separate. --Claude
summary: DNR record + ReserveMN read: CAMPGROUND CLOSED for construction (park reopens ~Oct 2027, campground ~May 2028) -> status temporarily_closed. 33 drive-in sites (32 online), 11 electric 30 A, $24/$34 (June 2027 prices still listed), 50-ft limit, pads 25-90 ft (all fit 23 ft); vault toilets, showers, dump. Derived fcfs cleared. Not waterfront kept. Pin OK. Phone none -> 320-216-3910. Website DNR URL 404s -> new URL.

Booking: fcfs 'some_sites' (derived from note prose) cleared so the state:MN 'never' applies; no DNR statement of walk-up sites at Banning.

Site access caveat: DNR 'long sites, but the turning radius to back into them is narrow'; ReserveMN site 3 'Road to campsite is narrow. Use caution with larger camping units.' Every pad is 25 ft or more, so a 23-ft rig fits; put in sites.note, not a criteria problem.
ReserveMN lists 10 electric units online against the DNR's 11; one site is not online.
Waterfront: keep not waterfront. ReserveMN gives every unit '.5 mile to river'; imagery shows the campground under continuous forest on the plateau.
Pin 46.15682,-92.85499 is ~90 m west of ReserveMN's facility point 46.15698,-92.85383 (the loop is under canopy); OK. The DNR park point 46.17964,-92.84876 is the ranger station area, ~2.6 km north.
